brief:
The World Health Organization has warned of mounting humanitarian and health catastrophe in Gaza as winter approaches, Shehab Wire reported. Nearly 950,000 displaced people face threats from flooding, disease outbreaks, and shortages of medical supplies amid deteriorating conditions.

The agency cautioned that the worst of the winter crisis has not yet arrived, signaling further deterioration expected in coming months as cold weather compounds existing vulnerabilities across the territory.
dek: The World Health Organization has warned of mounting humanitarian and health catastrophe in Gaza as winter approaches, Shehab Wire reported.
title: WHO warns Gaza winter threatens 950,000 displaced Palestinians
